name: Separation in space
description: Apply contradictory demands in different places in space.
guidelines: Use this approach when the contradictory demands apply to different places in space.

name: Separation in time
description: Apply contradictory demands at different moments in time.
guidelines: Use this approach when the contradictory demands are required at different moments in time.

name: Separation in relation (conditions)
description: Apply contradictory demands to different objects or under different conditions.
guidelines: Control question: for whom / for what object?
Use this approach when the contradictory demands apply to different objects.

name: Separation in direction
description: Apply contradictory demands in different directions of action.
guidelines: Use this approach when the contradictory demands apply to different directions of action.

name: Separation at the system level
description: Apply contradictory demands at different levels of the system.
guidelines: This approach may always be applied.
